Inspect PDF

See everything a PDF carries before you share it.

Read a PDF’s metadata, page geometry, fonts, forms, annotations, attachments, JavaScript and text-layer coverage in one report. Structural warnings flag the things that most often cause broken documents or accidental data leaks.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Inspect PDF works

  1. Add the PDF you want to understand.
  2. Review the report cards and severity warnings.
  3. Copy the report or download it as JSON for your records.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.

Related tools

  • Sanitize PDF — Strip active content, metadata and hidden payloads.
  • Edit Metadata — Fix the title, author and identity of a document.
  • Protect PDF — Real AES-256 encryption, never uploaded.
